DigitalIO.Name: MediaFlange.Gripper1_isOpen
DigitalIO.Description: Input from sensor: True if Gripper 1 is in the fully open position.

DigitalIO.Name: MediaFlange.Gripper1_isClosed
DigitalIO.Description: Input from sensor: True if Gripper 1 is in the fully closed position.

DigitalIO.Name: MediaFlange.Gripper2_isOpen
DigitalIO.Description: Input from sensor: True if Gripper 2 is in the fully open position.

DigitalIO.Name: MediaFlange.Gripper1_Switch
DigitalIO.Description: Control Output: Actuates the solenoid/valve to trigger Gripper 1 movement.

DigitalIO.Name: MediaFlange.Gripper2_Switch
DigitalIO.Description: Control Output: Actuates the solenoid/valve to trigger Gripper 2 movement.

DigitalIO.Name: MediaFlange.Gripper2_isClosed
DigitalIO.Description: Input from sensor: True if Gripper 2 is in the fully closed position.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionOutputs.DataRequestSent
DigitalIO.Description: Handshake to PLC: Robot has sent a request for new vision data.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionOutputs.PickPositionReady
DigitalIO.Description: Handshake to PLC: A valid Cartesian pick coordinate is ready for use.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionOutputs.CalibrationComplete
DigitalIO.Description: Handshake to PLC: The robot-vision calibration routine has successfully finished.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionInputs.CalibrationMode
DigitalIO.Description: PLC Command: Set robot application to Calibration State.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionInputs.CalibrationRequest
DigitalIO.Description: PLC Command: Initiate the hand-eye calibration procedure.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionInputs.DataRequest
DigitalIO.Description: PLC Command: Trigger a new camera capture and coordinate calculation.

DigitalIO.Name: VisionInputs.RunMode
DigitalIO.Description: PLC Command: Signals that the overall system is in production/automatic mode.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotCartesianPosition.X

DigitalIO.Name: RobotCartesianPosition.Y
DigitalIO.Description: TCP Y-Coordinate. Value is mm * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotCartesianPosition.Z
DigitalIO.Description: TCP Z-Coordinate. Value is mm * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotCartesianPosition.A
DigitalIO.Description: TCP Orientation A (Rotation around Z) in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotCartesianPosition.B
DigitalIO.Description: TCP Orientation B (Rotation around Y) in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotCartesianPosition.C
DigitalIO.Description: TCP Orientation C (Rotation around X) in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A1
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 1 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A2
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 2 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A3
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 3 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A4
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 4 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A5
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 5 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A6
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 6 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotJointPosition.A7
DigitalIO.Description: Joint angle Axis 7 in degrees * 10.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotStatus.IsInHome
DigitalIO.Description: System state: True when robot.isInHome() returns true.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotStatus.IsMastered
DigitalIO.Description: System state: True when robot.isMastered() returns true (all axes mastered).

DigitalIO.Name: RobotStatus.IsReadyToMove
DigitalIO.Description: System state: True when robot.isReadyToMove() returns true (Drives OK, Auto or Enabling signal issued).

DigitalIO.Name: RobotStatus.IsActive
DigitalIO.Description: System state: True when robot.hasActiveMotionCommand() returns true.

DigitalIO.Name: RobotStatus.IsReferenced
DigitalIO.Description: System state: True if position and torque sensors are referenced.
